explanation: The original structured review_provenance encodes target episode identity plus reviewed temporal/sensitivity binding state, but not structured qualifying-event, exact-city, air-context, or same-attack semantic fields.

The 145 accepted positives contain those required classifier semantics in the final/candidate evidence representation, so using them as outputs to manufacture missing review-provenance fields would be circular.

The negative controls show that reviewed binding shape alone is non-discriminative: 40/57 pre-cutoff unresolved controls carry reviewed temporal bindings and 10/57 carry reviewed sensitivity bindings.
Therefore mapping reviewed binding/disposition alone to the four missing semantic fields would violate the hard safety gate and would not be the historical contract.
